description: This file defines an abstract base test case class for testing Twig nodes. It includes methods for compiling nodes, asserting compilation results, and environment setup. It is used as a foundation for more specific node test classes within the Twig testing suite.

classes.name: NodeTestCase
classes.description: An abstract PHPUnit test case class for testing Twig Node objects, providing environment setup, compilation, and assertion methods.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns an array of test cases; meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: provideTests
methods.description: Provides iterable test data for testing node compilation; includes deprecation warning for not implementing in child classes.

methods.name: testCompile
methods.description: Test method that compiles a node and compares its generated source to expected output, using data providers.

methods.name: assertNodeCompilation
methods.description: Asserts that a node compiles to the expected source, optionally matching a pattern.

methods.name: getCompiler
methods.description: Creates and returns a Compiler instance, potentially with a custom environment.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the current Twig Environment, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: createEnvironment
methods.description: Creates a default Twig Environment with an ArrayLoader.

methods.name: getVariableGetter
methods.description: Deprecated method for generating variable getter code; use createVariableGetter instead.

methods.name: createVariableGetter
methods.description: Creates PHP code to retrieve a variable from Twig context.

methods.name: getAttributeGetter
methods.description: Deprecated method for generating attribute getter code; use createAttributeGetter instead.

methods.name: createAttributeGetter
methods.description: Creates PHP code for attribute retrieval in Twig.

methods.name: checkDataProvider
methods.description: Static method that checks the existence of getTests() method and issues deprecation warning if not overridden.
